pages.title: Jerky Curtains
pages.text: Race 5: San Francisco, 5.1 miles. Password: HILLS. Skitchin' (EA, 1994), Mega Drive / Genesis. Music by Jeff van Dyck.

pages.title: Odd names
pages.text: Jeff: 'I tried to make up the most bizarre names possible.' Most of them are about food: deep fry, liver, jerky, chicken, caffeine, junk, tuna, a cheese grater and a spicy placenta.

pages.title: Not new
pages.text: Skitching was older than the game: Marty McFly does it on a skateboard in Back to the Future (1985), and a courier in Snow Crash (1992) harpoons cars for a ride. Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 4 added it in 2002.
